Description_ZH: 当能量护盾破裂或填充时会触发星爆，造成14872伤害
Description_EN: Triggers a Star Burst dealing 14872 Damage when Energy Shield breaks or fills

Description_ZH: 受到伤害时，获得+15%元素抗性和+50%抗性（针对最后所受伤害类型），持续5秒
Description_EN: When damaged, gain +15% Elemental Resistance and +50% Resistance to the last damage type received for 5s

Description_ZH: 造成近战伤害时，生成流星星团砸向受伤害的敌人
Description_EN: When dealing Melee Damage, spawn a Meteor Cluster to fall on the damaged enemy

Description_ZH: 击杀时有50%几率生成弹药增强器，并立即补充枪械弹药
Description_EN: On kill, 50% chance to spawn an Ammo Booster and instantly refill Gun Ammo

Description_ZH: 近战击中时，消耗一个护甲段获得+100%近战伤害。当护甲护盾为0时，获得+50%近战伤害
Description_EN: On Melee Hit, consume an Armor Segment to gain +100% Melee Damage. When Armor Shield is 0, gain +50% Melee Damage

Description_ZH: 护甲段破裂时，获得753超强护盾
Description_EN: On Armor Segment break, grants 753 Overshield

Description_ZH: 最后一个护甲段破裂时生成护盾小子
Description_EN: Spawns a Shield Boi when the last Armor Segment breaks

Description_ZH: 装备后，获得+7436最大生命值，每秒恢复+372生命值，同时受到的伤害降低33%
Description_EN: While equipped, gain +7436 Max Health, regenerate +372 Health/s, and reduce Damage Taken by 33%

Description_ZH: 当护甲段破裂时，生成一个奇点
Description_EN: Spawns a Singularity when an Armor Segment breaks

Description_ZH: 段数破裂时生成杀戮无人机。该无机将与秘藏猎同时开火，复制当前枪械的元素并造成枪械伤害的25%伤害
Description_EN: On Segment break, spawn a Kill Drone that fires alongside the Vault Hunter, mimicing their Gun's Element and deals 25% of the Gun's Damage

Description_ZH: 受到伤害时，获得一层决心，每有一层决心，所受伤害减少2%，最多叠加25层。能量护盾破裂时将释放星爆，造成7436伤害，每有一层决心，该伤害提升+20%
Description_EN: When damaged, gain a stack of Determination. Each stack reduces Damage Taken by 2%, max 25 stacks. When Energy Shield breaks, release a Star Burst dealing 7436 Damage, increased by +20% per stack of Determination

Description_ZH: 通过落地猛击切换此效果开关。启用后，会持续消耗护盾并获得+40%加成电击伤害，但受到的伤害会直接穿透护盾
Description_EN: Toggle via Ground Slam. When active, continuously drains Shield to gain +40% Bonus Shock Damage, but incoming Damage bypasses Shield

Description_ZH: 能量护盾启动时，每秒恢复7041生命值
Description_EN: When energy shields are active, regenerates 7041 Health/s

Description_ZH: 能量护盾未满时，会周期性电击附近敌人
Description_EN: Periodically shocks nearby enemies while Energy Shield is not full

Description_ZH: 启用能量护盾时，被击中的敌人有12%几率掉落超强护盾。如拥有超强护盾，获得+25%电击伤害
Description_EN: When Energy Shield is active, damaged enemies have a 12% chance to drop Overshield. While you have Overshield, gain +25% Shock Damage

Description_ZH: 能量护盾破裂时，对3名敌人触发星爆并造成5577伤害
Description_EN: When Energy Shield breaks, trigger a Star Burst on 3 enemies dealing 5577 Damage

Description_ZH: 能量护盾破裂时，成杀戮无人机冲向附近敌人，造成6320伤害并恢复15%护盾。护盾全满时，杀戮无人机会再次冲击
Description_EN: When breaks, spawn that charge a nearby enemy, deal 6320 damage and restore 15% shield. recharge while is full.

Description_ZH: 护甲段破裂时，获得2秒伤害免疫
Description_EN: Gain 2 seconds of Damage Immunity when an Armor Segment breaks

Description_ZH: 装备后，在殊死一搏状态下可更快复活。当殊死一搏时间耗尽时，每300秒免费获得1次卷土重来
Description_EN: While equipped, revive faster in Fight For Your Life. Automatically gain a Second Wind when FFYL time expires (300s cooldown)

Description_ZH: 当能量护盾填充时，获得超强护盾。当能量护盾全满时，获得25%射速、25%移动速度，同时每秒恢复1弹药
Description_EN: Gain Overshield when Energy Shield fills. When Energy Shield is full, gain +25% Fire Rate, +25% Movement Speed, and regenerate 1 Ammo/s

Description_ZH: 启用护盾时自我伤害降低90%
Description_EN: Reduces self-Damage dealt by 90% while Shield is active

Description_ZH: 击杀时生成导弹，自动追踪附近敌人，每枚造成7436伤害
Description_EN: On kill, spawn Missiles that home in on nearby enemies, dealing 7436 Damage each

Description_ZH: 护甲护盾全满时，立刻失去一个护甲段
Description_EN: Immediately lose an Armor Segment when Armor Shield becomes full
